label: demo_fictional
note: Fictional notices and FAQ entries for the KAMI demo. Every time, number and rule in them is invented, including the helpline number.

notices.title: Piped water supply hours
notices.text: Piped water is supplied every day from 06:00 to 08:00 in the morning and from 17:00 to 19:00 in the evening.
notices.keywords: timing hours supply tap water when does water come arrive morning evening time
notices.keywords_hi: नल पानी सप्लाई आपूर्ति समय टाइम सुबह शाम nal paani pani supply timing samay

notices.title: How the tanker schedule works
notices.text: Each ward has a tanker schedule with a time slot of 2 hours. Ask this bot for your ward number or ward name to hear the slot and the current status of the tanker.
notices.keywords: tanker schedule slot how works ask ward
notices.keywords_hi: टैंकर समय-सारणी शेड्यूल स्लॉट tanker schedule slot

notices.title: Asking for an extra tanker
notices.text: An extra tanker can be requested at the ward office. Requests made before 12:00 are planned for the next day.
notices.keywords: extra additional tanker request order book
notices.keywords_hi: अतिरिक्त एक्स्ट्रा टैंकर मंगवाना मंगाना अनुरोध बुक extra tanker mangwana mangana

notices.title: Tanker charges
notices.text: Tanker water delivered under the ward schedule is free of charge. Nobody is allowed to ask for payment at the tanker.
notices.keywords: tanker cost price charge fee free money payment
notices.keywords_hi: टैंकर पैसे पैसा शुल्क मुफ्त मुफ़्त फ्री कीमत भुगतान tanker free paise paisa muft charge

notices.title: What to bring to the tanker
notices.text: Bring your own clean containers with lids. Each household can collect up to 200 litres per delivery.
notices.keywords: container bucket how much litres limit household collect bring
notices.keywords_hi: टैंकर बर्तन बाल्टी कितना लीटर परिवार घर ले tanker bartan balti kitna litre parivar

notices.title: How to report a damaged pipe
notices.text: Send a photo of the damaged pipe to this bot and share the location of the place. You get a ticket number. The photo is not analysed automatically; staff look at it.
notices.keywords: report damaged broken pipe photo complaint ticket location how
notices.keywords_hi: पाइप टूटी टूटा फूटी लीकेज शिकायत रिपोर्ट फोटो दर्ज pipe tooti tuti shikayat photo report

notices.title: What happens after a report
notices.text: A ticket is linked to the nearest sensor point and shown to the control room. Field staff visit within 2 working days.
notices.keywords: ticket after report follow up status visit staff when
notices.keywords_hi: टिकट शिकायत बाद कर्मचारी आएंगे ticket baad staff

notices.title: What the alert priorities mean
notices.text: The network monitor uses 4 priority levels: Low, Medium, High and Critical. High and Critical alerts are sent to the control room at once. An alert means the sensors show unusual behaviour; it does not say what the reason is.
notices.keywords: alert priority level low medium high critical meaning mean
notices.keywords_hi: अलर्ट प्राथमिकता स्तर स्तरों कम मध्यम उच्च गंभीर alert priority level

notices.title: What the alert categories mean
notices.text: Infrastructure means unusual flow or pressure. Quality means unusual turbidity or TDS. Combined means both at the same time.
notices.keywords: category infrastructure quality combined meaning turbidity tds flow pressure
notices.keywords_hi: अलर्ट श्रेणी इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चर गुणवत्ता संयुक्त टर्बिडिटी टीडीएस category shreni

notices.title: If the tap water looks cloudy
notices.text: If tap water looks cloudy or smells unusual, do not drink it. Use stored drinking water and report it through this bot or the helpline.
notices.keywords: cloudy dirty muddy smell colour unsafe drink water looks
notices.keywords_hi: गंदा गंदला मटमैला बदबू रंग पीने ganda gandla badbu matmaila

notices.title: Helpline
notices.text: The water helpline number in this demo is 1800-000-0000. It is a fictional number and cannot be called. The helpline hours are 08:00 to 20:00.
notices.keywords: helpline phone number call contact whom complaint
notices.keywords_hi: हेल्पलाइन फोन नंबर संपर्क कॉल helpline number phone sampark

notices.title: Ward office hours
notices.text: Ward offices are open from 10:00 to 17:00, Monday to Saturday. They are closed on Sunday.
notices.keywords: ward office open hours timing closed sunday visit
notices.keywords_hi: वार्ड कार्यालय दफ्तर ऑफिस खुलता खुलने बंद रविवार office karyalaya daftar khulta

notices.title: Paying the water bill
notices.text: Water bills can be paid at the ward office. The due date is the 15th of every month.
notices.keywords: bill pay payment due date water charges monthly
notices.keywords_hi: बिल भुगतान भरना जमा अंतिम तिथि तारीख bill bharna jama bhugtan

notices.title: New water connection
notices.text: Apply for a new water connection at the ward office with an identity proof and a property document. A new connection takes about 15 working days.
notices.keywords: new connection apply application documents how long
notices.keywords_hi: नया कनेक्शन आवेदन दस्तावेज़ naya connection aavedan

notices.title: Cleaning the overhead tank
notices.text: Clean your overhead tank and sump every 6 months and keep them covered.
notices.keywords: clean overhead tank sump how often cleaning
notices.keywords_hi: टंकी सफाई साफ ओवरहेड महीने tanki safai saaf

notices.title: Languages and voice notes
notices.text: This bot answers in Hindi and English. You can type or send a voice note of up to 60 seconds.
notices.keywords: language hindi english voice note speak type
notices.keywords_hi: भाषा हिंदी अंग्रेज़ी अंग्रेजी वॉइस नोट बोलकर bhasha hindi english voice
